features.title: Core Infrastructure: FastAPI backend + React frontend skeleton with SQLite storage
acceptance: FastAPI server starts on port 8000 with /health endpoint
React dev server starts on port 3000 and proxies API calls
SQLite database initializes with sessions, observations, and projects tables
One end-to-end workflow: create session -> add observation -> retrieve context

features.title: Observer Response Pipeline: classify outputs, preserve batches on failure, bound history
acceptance: Output classifier distinguishes valid, skip, idle, auth, overflow, xml_drift, prose_salvageable, prose
Policy table maps each class to {preserve|confirm|abort} batch decision
Token budget enforced on conversation history with truncation

features.title: Session Management: create, resume, complete sessions with context injection
acceptance: Session CRUD API with project association
Context injection retrieves relevant observations for a query
Session completion marks status and triggers summarization

features.title: Hook Integration: thin, fail-open Claude Code hooks
acceptance: Hook wrapper adds <60ms overhead on Unix, <300ms on Windows
Worker unavailable returns {continue:true} exit 0, never exit 2
No login shell spawn in common path
